notes: WITH-SKILL achieves PERFECT 100% pass rate (8/8) across all 6 runs with ZERO variance. WITHOUT-SKILL averages 85.4% with high variance (stddev 13.1%), ranging from 62.5% to 100%.

The skill's primary value is CONSISTENCY, not just quality. Without the skill, output quality is unpredictable — sometimes matching with-skill (100%) and sometimes failing badly (62.5%). The skill eliminates this variance entirely.

WITHOUT-SKILL failure modes: (1) skip rate > 15% when source overlaps with existing notes (vq-seq runs 2,3), (2) codebook collapse not captured when dedup correctly identifies it as existing (vq-seq runs 1,2), (3) summary section missing proper counts (vocalmat run-3), (4) titles as topic labels not claims (vocalmat run-3).

WITH-SKILL produces richer output structure: enrichment tasks (updates to existing notes), validations (confirming existing claims), and explicit skip-rate calibration. These categories are absent from all without-skill runs.

The skill costs +38% in time (255s vs 185s) and +44% in tokens (65K vs 46K). This overhead is spent on vault orientation (reading existing notes, running duplicate searches) which directly enables the consistency gains.

Assertion 8 (content-specific) reveals an interesting design tension for vq-sequential: without-skill runs that correctly deduplicate the codebook collapse finding FAIL the assertion because they don't re-extract it. The skill handles this by including it in enrichment tasks instead of skipping it entirely.

bias_analysis.description: Follow-up analysis testing whether the original 8 assertions were biased toward format compliance the skill prescribes.
new_substance_assertions: A9: Source faithfulness — no fabricated claims
A10: Enrichment identification — >=2 existing notes targeted for update
A11: Key methods comprehensiveness — >=2 of 3 key methods captured
A12: Pipeline-specific implementation ideas — names specific pipeline components
A13: Vault link accuracy — >=80% of [[wiki-linked]] existing notes are real
bias_analysis.conclusion: Gap narrowed from +14.6% (original) to +6.7% (substance). ~50% of the original advantage was format compliance. The remaining real advantage is enrichment identification (A10) — the skill's ability to identify existing notes needing updates, which 2/6 without-skill runs miss entirely. On faithfulness, method coverage, pipeline relevance, and vault link accuracy, both configs perform identically.
